description: Call before each tool call your agent makes. Send the calls so far and the one you are about to make, get back allowed true or false with the reason. Catches identical and near-repeat loops (same file, URL or command), re-reads of finished items, failing-tool retry streaks and USD or token caps before spend. Free, no account, arguments are not stored, nothing is executed. Smallest valid call: {"calls":[],"next":{"tool":"bash"}}

errorText.description: Error message when isError; permanent errors (missing binary, 4xx, quota, permission) halt after 1 retry

readOnly.description: Call had no side effects; lets the opt-in completed-read rule apply

resultHash.description: Stable hash of the tool result; repeats with the same hash count as no progress

totalCostUsd.description: Running session spend so far; spend becomes max(spend, total)

name: guard_check_session
title: Loop and budget guard
